add.title: Add an account
add.description: Accounts live on this machine; messages sync locally and work offline.
add.gmailDescription: Sign in with your Google account in the browser. Needs a Google Client ID (free).
add.microsoftDescription: Sign in with your Microsoft account in the browser — work, school or personal (Outlook, Hotmail, Live). Needs a one-time app registration (free).
add.imapDescription: Yahoo, iCloud, Fastmail, GMX, Zoho or any provider — with your email address and password.

steps.consent: Waiting for you to finish in the browser…

oauth.enterGoogleClientId: Enter your Google OAuth Client ID to continue.
oauth.enterMicrosoftClientId: Enter your Microsoft app registration's Client ID to continue.

gmail.title: Connect Gmail
gmail.waiting: A Google sign-in page opened in your browser. Finish there — this window continues automatically.
gmail.description: Paste your own Google OAuth Client ID (type “Desktop app”). It is stored on this device only.

microsoft.title: Connect Microsoft 365
microsoft.waiting: A Microsoft sign-in page opened in your browser. Finish there — this window continues automatically.
microsoft.description: Emailer has no built-in Microsoft app, so a one-time personal registration is needed. It stays on this device only.
microsoft.registerHelp: In the Azure portal register an app (type “Accounts in any organizational directory and personal Microsoft accounts”), then add the redirect URIhttp://localhost:{{port}}as a mobile and desktop platform entry. No client secret is needed.
microsoft.adminHelp: Work or school account? Your organization may require admin approval for the app registration — if sign-in reports that admin approval is needed, ask your IT administrator to grant it.

imap.identityDescription: Your address and password stay on this device; known providers are filled in automatically.
imap.brandDetected: {{brand}} detected — server settings will be prefilled.
imap.microsoftHint: Outlook/Hotmail/Live addresses connect better via “Microsoft 365 / Outlook.com” on the previous screen (modern OAuth sign-in instead of a password).
imap.enterPassword: Enter the account password (or app password).
imap.autoFilledBrand: Auto-filled from {{brand}}'s known settings — edit if they differ.
imap.autoFilled: Auto-filled from this provider's known settings — edit if they differ.
imap.unknownProvider: This provider is not in the known list — enter the server details from your provider.

reauth.waitingMicrosoft: A Microsoft sign-in page opened in your browser for {{email}}. Finish there — this window continues automatically.
reauth.waitingGoogle: A Google sign-in page opened in your browser for {{email}}. Finish there — this window continues automatically.
reauth.brokenMicrosoft: Microsoft reports this account's sign-in no longer works. Re-authorize {{email}} in the browser — your local mail is kept.
reauth.brokenGoogle: Google reports this account's sign-in no longer works. Re-authorize {{email}} in the browser — your local mail is kept.
reauth.passwordRejected: The server rejected {{email}}'s password. Enter the new one — both the incoming and outgoing connections are tested before it is saved, and your local mail is kept.
reauth.enterNewPassword: Enter the new password (or app password).

remove.title: Remove account
remove.description: Remove <email>{{email}}</email> from this device? Every locally stored message, thread and label of this account will be deleted. The account itself is not deleted at the provider — adding it again syncs fresh from the server.

historyWindow.fieldHint: Applies to the first sync only — messages older than this are left on the server. New mail always syncs.
